description: The digest the analytics pipeline is pinned to, read from infra/gcp/pipeline.tf, still exists in Artifact Registry: the registry's cleanup policy has not removed the image the next run needs
unlinked_reason: A safety net for the retention decision (registers/retention.yaml), not a matrix row: it keeps the Artifact Registry cleanup policy from silently breaking the pipeline that SVC-VCM and SVC-VRI are judged against.
